pages.name: Home screen
pages.intro: Two calls about the home screen: the header layout, and the line shown when the list is empty.

records.title: Home header: two lines or one
records.surface: The home screen header shows the title and the date on two lines.

options.text: Keep the header on two lines.
Put the title and the date on one line; the header loses 18 px of height.

recommend.why: It gives the list more room and changes nothing else.

records.rule_or_precedent: A visible change is the owner's call.

options.A: The header stays on two lines.
options.B: The title and the date share one line.

records.title: Empty list: one short line
records.surface: The home list, when it has no rows.
records.proposal: Replace the two-sentence empty-list text with one line: "Nothing here yet."
records.rule_or_precedent: Copy changes ship on the owner's approval.

writes_back.on_approve:
## Decision

Owner, {date}, decision page 1 (Home screen): **approved**.
